verdict.rationale: Dashboards are a fair axis for a product-analytics platform like Pendo, but the evidence pack never mentions dashboards, saved insights, or sharing reports with a team. The closest items cover analytics, path tracking, Snowflake/cloud export, and Leo alerts, which are adjacent features and do not show dashboard composition or sharing.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can compose saved insights into shareable dashboards for my team
